title: The bad-fit example of the thesis: loss-making genomics lab

input.facts: Clinical genomic testing services. Loss-making for five years; growth depends on obtaining Medicare reimbursement for its main test, decision pending. Leverage is not meaningful with negative EBITDA. The share price fell 55%. No large holder. No regulatory issue beyond the pending reimbursement decision.

why: This is the thesis own bad-fit example: not profitable, growth hangs on a reimbursement decision. No kill criterion is met, so Watch rather than Reject.
